package.name: sim_vehicle
package.description: Hardware-free stand-in for vehicle_bridge + GPS + EKF localization. Integrates a kinematic bicycle model from /vehicle/cmd_speed, /vehicle/cmd_steer, /vehicle/cmd_gear and publishes /odom_fused plus the two localization-ready flags, so waypoint_follower can be driven and watched in rviz without any real GPS/IMU/encoder/serial hardware.
